Uddhav Thackeray launches 'Ram Raksha Andolan' campaign

Uddhav Thackeray has launched a new campaign named 'Ram Raksha Andolan' in Maharashtra. This initiative appears to be related to a dispute over donations for Ayodhya. The campaign's launch signifies a political move by Thackeray's faction.
